info.name: Disaster Aid System — API Test Collection
info.description:
Covers every documented endpoint in the project's CLAUDE.md API reference — built for gathering dissertation testing-evidence screenshots (request + response side by side).

SETUP (do this once):
1. Start the backend: `cd server && npm run dev` (listens on http://localhost:5000).
2. Set the collection variables `email`/`password` to a real test account you already registered through the app's own /register screen (any role), and `adminEmail`/`adminPassword` to a real admin account.
3. Run the two requests in "0. Auth" once — their Tests scripts save real ID tokens into {{idToken}}/{{adminIdToken}} automatically. Every other request in this collection already points at those variables.
4. Work through the numbered folders top to bottom — several requests (submit a request, register a donation, match a donation, submit SOS, submit a community report) auto-capture the id they create (requestId, donationId, deliveryId, sosId, communityReportId) into collection variables via their own Tests scripts, so later requests in the same folder that reference {{requestId}} etc. just work without manual copy-pasting.
5. For anything not auto-captured (volunteerId, chatId, district, categoryKey, broadcastId, notificationId, waterAlertId, otherDeliveryId, handoffId), fill in the collection variable yourself from a real id you see in another response or in Firestore.

For a screenshot: Send the request, then screenshot Postman's request pane + response pane together (shows the method, URL, auth, and the real JSON response in one shot).
